text: This is Keelson. An agent harness that runs on your own machine.
Start the server with keelson start.
Now run a workflow. The smoke test exercises every node type. Prompts, commands, loops, bash, and scripts, wired together as a DAG.
Nine nodes, a few seconds, all green.
Every workflow is also in the browser. Find the smoke test, and hit Run.
The graph lights up as each node finishes. You can see which model answered, how long it took, and the output.
And it's all stored locally, so nothing is lost when you close the tab.
Keelson. Install it with one line, and run your first workflow.
